decisions.reason: Offshore and renewable energy vessel management is a strategic growth area for a large ship manager like BSM, and it was set up as a dedicated business unit, so it is likely to be kept.
Crew travel management is closely tied to the core crewing business and stayed relevant after COVID crew-change disruptions, though it could be folded into another unit.
An online vessel information portal supports client transparency and digitalisation, but such portals are often replaced or rebranded within integrated digital platforms.
A mobile performance app fits the push for decarbonisation and digital reporting, but standalone apps carry a higher risk of being consolidated into a broader platform.
